description: This file defines the RequestInfo data structure and the RequestInfoFactory for parsing HTTP requests into structured request information within the Kubernetes API server. It includes logic for interpreting URL paths, HTTP methods, and query parameters to determine resource, subresource, namespace, and action details.

classes.name: RequestInfo
classes.description: Struct holding parsed information from an HTTP request, including resource details, namespace, verb, path, and selectors.

classes.name: RequestInfoFactory
classes.description: Factory for creating RequestInfo objects by parsing HTTP requests, based on API prefixes and path structure.

methods.name: NewRequestInfo
methods.description: Parses an HTTP request to produce a RequestInfo object containing resource, namespace, verb, and other request details.

methods.name: WithRequestInfo
methods.description: Associates a RequestInfo object with a context.

methods.name: RequestInfoFrom
methods.description: Retrieves a RequestInfo object from a context.

methods.name: splitPath
methods.description: Splits a URL path into its segments.
